flows.presentationHost: U03 reusable review/progress components; do not rewrite intent as a simple transfer
steps: resolve immutable intent/source and authorized wallet
render action-specific fields and verify supported signer profile
request physical approval for HW or MPC participant policy for Cloud
verify returned proof/signature against intended payload
submit only through the source-specific adapter
resume using intent/operation/transaction or protocol request reference
constraints: merchant_refund uses merchant-authorized signer, never customer payment.prepare
DID/x402 use their selected protocol proof adapter; not all proofs are raw transactions
smart-account submission DTO is separate from the EOA DTO subset
unsupported signature formats are rejected; no blind-signing fallback
no private keys in navigation parameters
